name: Mateo Vargas
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport IT began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in computer science from the Pontifical Catholic University of Peru, he initially worked for a large telecommunications company. A chance encounter at a local karting event, where he volunteered to help fix the timing system's software glitches, sparked his passion. This led him to pursue opportunities within racing, eventually landing him at United Autosports.

As the IT Systems Manager, Mateo is responsible for ensuring the seamless operation of all technology infrastructure, from the garage's data acquisition systems to the team's communications network. He takes a methodical approach, prioritizing stability and security. While not always the first to embrace the newest tech, his thoroughness and dedication make him a reliable asset. He is particularly adept at troubleshooting complex issues under pressure, a skill honed by years of experience dealing with the unpredictable nature of racing technology.

Mateo's loyalty to United Autosports is unwavering. He values the team's camaraderie and the shared pursuit of excellence. While he may not be the loudest voice in the room, his quiet dedication and technical expertise make him an invaluable part of the organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even to meetings.
Insists on backing up every file at least twice.
Has a specific brand of Peruvian coffee that he brews in the office every morning.
